title: Migrate blackfreedomstudies.org from Craft CMS
description: Full migration of blackfreedomstudies.org away from Craft CMS. Phases: 1) Audit existing site content and structure, 2) Select target stack, 3) Content modeling and frontend build, 4) Content migration, 5) QA and launch.

title: Audit existing Craft CMS site content and structure
description: Catalog all content types, entries, assets, templates, and URL structure on blackfreedomstudies.org. Document sections, fields, relationships, and any custom plugins or modules in use.

title: Fix CSS isolation between classic and redesign themes
description: Both theme CSS files load on every page because theme.ts imports both layouts which import both CSS files. Classic theme shows redesign serif fonts and amber underlines. Need to ensure only the active theme's CSS loads.
close_reason: CSS isolation fixed: unified BaseLayout loads theme CSS via conditional link tag. No more cross-theme style bleeding.

title: Fix classic theme footer links not clickable
description: Classic footer shows @SchomburgCBFS and email as plain text, not as anchor links.
close_reason: Fixed in BaseLayout — footer links are proper anchor tags.

title: Fix homepage hero image handling
description: Both themes show hero section without image because homepage content file has no image set. Either add an image to the content, or make the hero degrade gracefully without one.
close_reason: Homepage shows h1+news links fallback when no hero image is set.

title: Fix news item titles not styled as links in redesign
description: News index page titles render but lack link styling on hover in the redesign theme.
close_reason: News item links now have proper color and hover state in redesign CSS.

title: Design review: Navbar (both themes)
description: Review navbar for both classic and redesign themes. Check: brand display, nav link order and labels, mobile responsive toggle, active link state, spacing, alignment. Compare classic navbar against original Craft site. Evaluate redesign navbar for readability and navigation clarity. Capture design options if multiple approaches exist.

title: Design review: Footer (both themes)
description: Review footer for both classic and redesign themes. Check: sponsor attribution, social links, contact info, spacing, link styling. Classic should match original. Redesign should feel institutional but modern. Note any missing content or broken links.

title: Design review: Homepage (both themes)
description: Review homepage for both themes. Check: hero section image/fallback, news overlay, intro body text, overall first impression. Verify copy matches original site. Classic should recreate the original hero pattern. Redesign should make a strong editorial first impression. Note any migration artifacts in the copy.

title: Design review: About page (both themes)
description: Review about page copy and layout. Check for migration artifacts like Craft asset tags ({asset:NNN:transform}), broken image references, formatting issues. Verify all paragraphs transferred correctly. Compare against original site content. Check typography, spacing, and readability in both themes.

title: Design review: Events index / all seasons listing (both themes)
description: Review events index page showing all seasons. Check: season ordering (reverse chronological), season labels (e.g. Spring 2025), event counts per season. Classic should show a simple list. Redesign uses timeline cards. Verify all seasons from 2013-2026 are present. Check for missing or duplicate seasons.

title: Design review: Season page / per-season event listing (both themes)
description: Review a season page (e.g. /events/spring-2025). Check: event cards display date, title, speaker count. Events sorted chronologically within season. Verify all events in the season are listed. Check card layout and click targets. Redesign cards should have hover states. Compare event count against audit data.

title: Select target platform and tech stack
description: Evaluate and choose the replacement platform for Craft CMS (e.g., static site generator, headless CMS, or other). Consider hosting, maintainability, cost, and editorial workflow needs.
notes: DECISION: Astro (static site generator) + Decap CMS (git-based visual editor) + Netlify or Cloudflare Pages hosting. Rationale: site is read-heavy with infrequent updates, relational content maps to Astro content collections, Decap gives editors a visual admin panel without needing a database or server. Zero hosting cost, zero maintenance.
close_reason: Selected Astro + Decap CMS on Netlify/Cloudflare Pages. Static site, git-backed CMS, zero-database architecture.

title: Design review: Event detail page (both themes)
description: Review event detail page. Check: date header, title, description body copy, speaker list with photos, video embed if present, primary resources, Eventbrite link for future events. Verify speaker references resolve correctly. Check for HTML artifacts in description. Compare layout between themes. Redesign should feel like an editorial exhibition panel.

title: Design review: Speakers index (both themes)
description: Review speakers grid/list. Check: alphabetical ordering, headshot images loading, names and affiliations displayed, links to detail pages working. Note speakers without images. Classic uses a simple grid, redesign uses a more polished card grid with hover effects. Verify speaker count matches audit (288).

title: Design review: Speaker detail page (both themes)
description: Review speaker detail page. Check: headshot, name, affiliation, social links (website/email/twitter), bio text (check for HTML artifacts), appearances list linking to correct events. Verify appearances are reverse chronological. Compare profile layout between themes.

title: Design review: News index (both themes)
description: Review news listing page. Check: reverse chronological order, date formatting, title links working, banner images if present. Verify news count matches audit (52). Check for missing or truncated entries. Compare layout between themes.

title: Design review: News detail page (both themes)
description: Review a news detail page. Check: banner image with caption, date display, body copy (check for HTML/migration artifacts), tags display. Verify content matches original site. Check typography and readability in both themes.

title: Design review: Resources index (both themes)
description: Review resources listing page. Check: grouped by type (Video, Document, External), links working, titles correct. Verify resource count matches audit (87). Check for missing resources or broken external links. Compare grouping and layout between themes.

title: Design review: 404 page (both themes)
description: Review 404 page for both themes. Check: appropriate messaging, link back to homepage, styling consistent with theme. Navigate to a non-existent URL to test.

title: Design content model for new platform
description: Map existing Craft CMS content types and fields to the new platform's content model. Define schemas, relationships, and taxonomies.
close_reason: Content model designed: 5 Astro collections (events, speakers, resources, news, pages) with denormalized seasons, single resources collection with discriminator, URL structure preserving existing patterns.

title: Export content from Craft CMS
description: Extract all content entries, assets (images, documents), and metadata from the Craft CMS database. Produce portable data files (JSON/CSV) and download all media assets.
close_reason: Exported 110 events, 288 speakers, 87 resources, 50 news, 4 pages + 1,656 asset files to Astro format

title: Build frontend for new site
description: Develop the new site frontend, matching or improving upon the existing blackfreedomstudies.org design. Implement responsive layouts, navigation, and all page templates.
close_reason: Dual-theme Astro frontend built (classic + redesign). All pages, components, CSS, theme switching, Decap CMS, Cloudflare/Netlify deploy configs.

title: Import content into new platform
description: Migrate exported content and assets into the new platform. Verify data integrity, fix broken references, and ensure all media is properly linked.
close_reason: Content already imported directly into src/content/ by export script. Build succeeds with 484 pages.

title: Set up URL redirects and SEO preservation
description: Map old Craft CMS URLs to new site URLs. Configure 301 redirects to preserve SEO. Verify meta tags, sitemap, and structured data carry over.
close_reason: URLs preserved 1:1 from Craft. Sitemap added. Trailing slash handling configured. No redirects needed — route structure matches.

title: Configure hosting and DNS
description: Set up production hosting for the new site. Configure DNS records to point blackfreedomstudies.org to the new host. Set up SSL/TLS certificates.

title: QA testing and launch
description: End-to-end testing of the migrated site: verify all pages render, links work, assets load, forms function. Cross-browser and mobile testing. Final launch cutover.
